name: GraphicsRules.sgr: real VRAM fallback under DXVK
author: sims-3-modernization
notes: [verified 2026-10-11] Under DXVK the engine reads texture memory as 0, so GraphicsRules.sgr falls back to 32 MB (DeviceConfig.log: "Texture memory: 32MB <<OVERRIDE>>"), GPU memory level Low, and the first-run detection writes low presets (texture/sim/lighting/terrain quality 1; vanilla D3D9 picked 3-4). textureMemory only feeds those presets (no runtime budget in the rules), so the game must redo detection: delete Options.ini, start the game once, then re-run options-ini. Steam "verify files" reverts the patch.

name: GraphicsRules.sgr ResourceCache CacheBudget (offload phase 0)
author: sims-3-modernization
notes: Experiment, not a fix. Patches GraphicsRules.sgr `setProp $ResourceGroup CacheBudget` (Default.ini [Resources] CacheBudget is ignored by the game [verified 2026-10-12: all 20 copies at 50 MB, /rescache still 200]). Sets the generic ResourceCache budget (docs/08 §2.5; EA default 209,715,200 B = 200 MB). Value from --cache-budget-mb (0..476), else config.mb. Phase 0 runs 200, 50 and 0; what 0 does (no caching of unreferenced resources, or unbounded) is [to measure]: watch /rescache. Re-installing with another value keeps the first backup; uninstall restores EA's file.
